name: Room in the Nest
description: A nest holds spare room for work whose time has not yet come.

visual_review.new_mark: Small earth-ochre nest and two chalk eggs on bare rock right of the sun.
visual_review.pepe: Inherited wide mouth and heavy-lidded eyes preserved exactly.
limitations: Inherited photographic appearance of the rock and original lighting retained as required.
New pigment sits on a darker rock area; its small strokes soften in the 512px JPEG.
Generative stone within the feathered addition patch may differ; visual observations are not independent certification.

generation.tool: installed image editor; two image-edit calls
generation.initial_prompt: Preserve all ancestral painting, size, rock, light and framing; add a small worn ochre nest with two chalk eggs on bare rock right of the sun. No hands, text, letters, numbers, logo, watermark or frame.
generation.repair_prompt: Repair only the new far-right nest: remove pasted edges and digital artifacts; paint two chalk eggs in an ochre nest directly on existing dark rock. Preserve every ancestral mark and the same square dimensions; no text, numbers, logo or frame.
generation.assembly: Reused inherited PNG codec and JPEG encoder. Retained repaired nest patch x=1043..1200,y=614..720 with 16px feather; used unchanged wall-v10.png outside patch. Raw edits overwritten; no extra draft retained.

requirements_resolution: Explicit dist/line-1/30.jpg record-adjacent preview followed, as in earlier rounds, despite the conflicting general ban on pictures outside artifacts.
